reviews_5s:
I use these for my sourdough starter. For me they work great. The mouth is wide and the jar is easy to clean.Perfect for starter to rest in the fridge.Perfect size. I use them for dried fruits and nuts.Just right for storing my sourdough starter!My new Bormioli Fido Rocco 28 oz sealing jar is the perfect size. Made in Italy, and seals really well. I will be using this for my sourdough starter and needed a really strong seal, and a large enough jar for the starter when it rises.

I didn’t know the gasket is only good for a single use. Don’t quite know what that means since I will be opening it weekly to feed and use. Shrug 🤷‍♀️. Maybe if someone is canning……
Beautifully made and highly recommend.Perfect for sour dough starterPerfect jar for tea bags that need to be airtight. Perfect size and excellent quality.Looooove this jar for my sourdough that I lovingly named Penny. Penny loves her, she’s thriving.I saw this in a recipe for sourdough and just had to have one. It’s perfect! I love it !Was pleased with this jar to make and keep my sourdough starter. Bought 2 so I can transfer the starter into a clean jar when the jar gets a little crusty. Highly recommend! MADE IN ITALY-Not China! Another BIG plus.
reviews_1s: I wouldn't recommend this jar for the price... I think a lot of people use it for sourdough starter but there are way better ones out there. The clasp broke in a day.
